items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1959-09-25
items.q: Gigs was with the Sutton fellow and made records

ctx.x: Did you have any steady gigs there?

Yeah, that's what I'm talking about. Gigs was with the Sutton fellow and made records, and then they called me for that jam session down on 2nd Street. Where they called? I believe it was, I don't know New York City. 22nd, eh?
